source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bottom = max(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(row))
    out = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        shift = bottom - r
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            nc = c - shift
            if value and 0 <= nc < w:
                out[r][nc] = value
    return out
'''
